PDF Page Rotator

Rotate PDF pages that came out sideways — rotate selected pages or the whole document by 90°, 180° or 270°, then download the fixed PDF.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your PDF.
  2. Choose which pages to rotate (or all pages).
  3. Pick 90°, 180° or 270° clockwise.
  4. Click “Rotate & download” to save the fixed PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the rotation permanent?

The rotation is written into the PDF file itself, so it stays fixed in every reader and printer.

Can I rotate only some pages?

Yes — specify individual pages or ranges like “1, 4-6”, or choose “All pages”.

Does rotating reduce quality?

pdf-lib adds the rotation to each page's existing rotation value, so two 90° turns equal 180° — it never degrades quality.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No — your PDF never leaves your device.
